name: Viện Phương Nam WorkBuddy-like course landing page

data.purpose: Codes, dates, labels, and compact values

contactRail.role: real phone, website, and back-to-top actions

rules.name: Original reference grammar
rules.body: Use the WorkBuddy-like composition and rhythm without Tencent branding, copy, assets, or URLs.

rules.name: Source truth
rules.body: Reconcile dates, codes, fees, contacts, payment, faculty facts, and certificate rules to the notices. Do not invent registration URLs, QR codes, standalone R pricing, or outcome claims.

rules.name: Workbench honesty
rules.body: Mark the HTML/CSS product window as a demo and never present simulated rows or outputs as real research results.

rules.name: Motion with purpose
rules.body: Use restrained reveal, tab transition, hover feedback, and one ambient workbench loop. Honor reduced motion.

rules.name: Accessible structure
rules.body: Maintain one h1, visible focus, skip link, keyboard tabs, native FAQ details, real tel links, and no horizontal overflow.
